scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others "pnpm --dir app dev" "wait-on http://localhost:3000 && pnpm tauri dev --no-dev-server-wait"
scripts.dev:mobile: concurrently --kill-others "pnpm --dir app dev --host" "wait-on http://localhost:3000 && pnpm tauri android dev --no-dev-server-wait"
scripts.build: pnpm --dir app generate && pnpm tauri build
scripts.build:apk: pnpm --dir app generate && pnpm tauri android build --apk
